name: Kotivon Call to Action
author: Kotivon Software ⭐

sections.description:
Add a sticky and elegant CTA to your website to improve conversions.
This plugin allows you to add a floating WhatsApp and Call button with a single toggle button.

Key Features:
* ✅ Floating WhatsApp and Phone buttons
* ✅ Single toggle button for clean design
* ✅ Fully responsive and mobile optimized
* ✅ Modern SVG icons – no external dependencies
* ✅ Professional design with smooth animations
* ✅ Fully customizable colors for all buttons
* ✅ Easy configuration from WordPress admin
* ✅ GDPR compliant – no data collection
* ✅ Lightweight and fast loading
* ✅ Cross-browser compatible

Perfect for:
* Business websites
* E-commerce stores
* Service providers
* Local businesses
* Any website wanting to increase contact rates

The plugin uses modern CSS animations and crisp SVG icons to ensure compatibility across all devices and browsers without requiring external libraries.

Support

For support questions, please visit kotivon.com or contact us through WordPress support forums.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data from your website visitors. When visitors click the WhatsApp or phone buttons, they will be redirected to their respective applications (WhatsApp or phone dialer) – no data is stored or transmitted by this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Kotivon CTA and configure your phone numbers
  4. Enter your WhatsApp number (format: 905xxxxxxxxx)
  5. Enter your phone number (format: +905xxxxxxxxx)
  6. Save settings and check your website frontend
sections.faq:
Can I change the button positions?

Currently, the buttons appear at the bottom-right of the screen. This is the most effective position for conversion rates.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes, fully responsive with optimized sizing for mobile devices.

Do I need both WhatsApp and Phone numbers?

No, you can use just one. If you leave a field empty, that button won’t appear.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, the plugin uses high z-index and !important CSS to ensure compatibility with all themes.

Does it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight with inline CSS/JS and no external dependencies.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes! You can customize the colors of WhatsApp, Phone, and Toggle buttons from the admin panel (Settings > Kotivon CTA).

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, the plugin doesn’t collect any user data or use tracking cookies.
